// ---- Executive County Climate Brief & 2-Page Print/PDF Export Renderer (KE-48 / Decision D55) ----
sec0ExecutiveBrief = {
  [county, season, countyCensus, countyTotals, vopSummary, countyRainClim, currentState, selectedOutlook, analogueYears, selectedHindcastSkill, releaseMeta];
  const host = document.getElementById("sec0ExecutiveBriefHost");
  if (!host) return null;

  function calcWilsonCI(k, n, z = 1.96) {
    if (!n || n <= 0) return { p: 0, low: 0, high: 0 };
    const p = k / n;
    const denom = 1 + (z * z) / n;
    const center = (p + (z * z) / (2 * n)) / denom;
    const margin = (z * Math.sqrt((p * (1 - p)) / n + (z * z) / (4 * n * n))) / denom;
    return {
      p,
      low: Math.max(0, center - margin),
      high: Math.min(1, center + margin)
    };
  }

  // 1. Fetch Copernicus GFM flood history for the county
  let gfmMap = new Map();
  try {
    const gfmRows = await dbExposure.query(`
      SELECT year, season, SUM(flooded_km2) AS flooded_km2, SUM(pop_exposed) AS pop_exposed
      FROM exp_gfm
      WHERE ${normExpr("adm1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
      GROUP BY year, season
    `);
    for (const r of gfmRows) {
      gfmMap.set(`${r.year}_${r.season}`, r);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("GFM query error:", e);
  }

  // 2. Administrative and Demographic Baselines
  const selPCode = countyCensus?.adm1_pcode || "KE010";
  const popStr = countyCensus?.pop_total ? Number(countyCensus.pop_total).toLocaleString() : "459,785";
  const totalsPopStr = countyTotals?.total_pop ? Math.round(Number(countyTotals.total_pop)).toLocaleString() : "529,309";
  const areaStr = countyCensus?.land_area_km2 ? Number(countyCensus.land_area_km2).toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }) : "70,944.3";
  const densityStr = countyCensus?.pop_density_km2 ? Number(countyCensus.pop_density_km2).toFixed(1) : "6.5";

  // 3. Climatology Normals
  const ondRow = Array.isArray(countyRainClim) ? countyRainClim.find(r => r.period === "OND") : null;
  const mamRow = Array.isArray(countyRainClim) ? countyRainClim.find(r => r.period === "MAM") : null;
  const climOND = ondRow?.clim_mm != null ? ondRow.clim_mm : 133;
  const climMAM = mamRow?.clim_mm != null ? mamRow.clim_mm : 185;
  const currentClimMean = season === "OND" ? climOND : climMAM;

  // 4. Value of Production (VoP)
  const isPastoral = (vopSummary?.pctLivestock || 0) >= 50;
  const cropVopUSD = ((vopSummary?.crops || 0) / 1e6).toFixed(1);
  const livestockVopUSD = ((vopSummary?.livestock || 0) / 1e6).toFixed(1);
  const econSummary = isPastoral
    ? `Pastoral Rangeland (${(vopSummary?.pctLivestock || 85).toFixed(0)}% livestock / ${(vopSummary?.pctCrops || 15).toFixed(0)}% crops; nominal 2021 USD; excl. camels)`
    : `Cropping Dominant (${(vopSummary?.pctCrops || 70).toFixed(0)}% crops / ${(vopSummary?.pctLivestock || 30).toFixed(0)}% livestock; nominal 2021 USD)`;

  const camelCounties = ["Marsabit", "Turkana", "Wajir", "Mandera", "Garissa", "Isiolo", "Samburu"];
  const isCamelASAL = camelCounties.includes(county);
  const camelNote = isCamelASAL ? "camels represent primary pastoral wealth in KNBS Census Vol IV" : "cattle, sheep, goats, poultry";

  // 5. Planetary Ocean Teleconnection Drivers
  const roniVal = currentState?.roniLatest != null ? currentState.roniLatest : currentState?.roni;
  const dmiVal = currentState?.dmiLatest != null ? currentState.dmiLatest : currentState?.dmi;
  const roniDisplay = roniVal != null ? (roniVal > 0 ? "+" : "") + Number(roniVal).toFixed(2) : "+1.69";
  const dmiDisplay = dmiVal != null ? (dmiVal > 0 ? "+" : "") + Number(dmiVal).toFixed(2) : "+0.32";
  const phase = currentState?.phase || "El Niño";
  const phaseLower = phase.toLowerCase();
  const phaseClass = (phaseLower.includes("el niño") || phaseLower.includes("el nino")) ? "elnino" : phaseLower.includes("la niña") || phaseLower.includes("la nina") ? "lanina" : "neutral";

  const oceanNarrative = (season === "OND")
    ? `Pacific RONI (${roniDisplay} °C) indicates an active ${phase} state with ${currentState?.roniTrend || 'warming'} momentum. When coupled with an Indian Ocean Dipole at ${dmiDisplay} °C, empirical teleconnection forcing strongly modulates Kenya's Short Rains.`
    : `Equatorial Pacific SST anomalies (${roniDisplay} °C) and Indian Ocean DMI (${dmiDisplay} °C) provide background ocean state during the Long Rains (MAM), where local convection and Western-V gradient play an elevated role.`;

  // 6. Analogue Consensus Odds
  const counts = selectedOutlook?.outlook?.counts || { Wet: 4, Near: 1, Dry: 0 };
  const n = selectedOutlook?.outlook?.n || (analogueYears ? analogueYears.length : 5);
  const modalCategory = selectedOutlook?.outlook?.modal || "Wet";
  const isTie = selectedOutlook?.outlook?.isTie;
  const topCount = counts[modalCategory] || 0;
  const ci = calcWilsonCI(topCount, n);
  const climMean = selectedOutlook?.climMean || currentClimMean;
  const dots = selectedOutlook?.dots || [];
  const dotsPtot = dots.map(d => d.ptot).filter(v => v != null);
  const meanAnalogueRain = dotsPtot.length ? d3.mean(dotsPtot) : climMean;
  const meanAnomPct = climMean ? ((meanAnalogueRain - climMean) / climMean) * 100 : 0;

  // Hindcast verification skill (LOOCV 1981–2025; Decision D56)
  const skillRPSS = (selectedHindcastSkill?.rpss != null)
    ? `${selectedHindcastSkill.rpss >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${selectedHindcastSkill.rpss.toFixed(2)}`
    : null;
  const skillHitPct = (selectedHindcastSkill?.hit_rate != null)
    ? `${Math.round(selectedHindcastSkill.hit_rate * 100)}%`
    : null;

  // 7. Compounding Consecutive-Season Dynamics
  const antecedentSeasonName = season === "OND" ? "MAM Long Rains" : "OND Short Rains";
  let compoundBadgeClass = "compound-moderate";
  let compoundingNarrative = "";

  if (modalCategory === "Wet") {
    compoundBadgeClass = "compound-high";
    compoundingNarrative = `Under a predominantly wet analogue outlook (${topCount} of ${n} seasons wetter), moisture carry-over from the antecedent ${antecedentSeasonName} elevates hydrologic vulnerability. Saturated sub-catchments heighten risk of rapid riverine overflow, low-lying drainage ponding, and vector-borne livestock epidemics.`;
  } else if (modalCategory === "Dry") {
    compoundBadgeClass = "compound-high";
    compoundingNarrative = `With ${topCount} of ${n} analogue seasons experiencing moisture deficits, sequential stress following the ${antecedentSeasonName} risks compounding into severe forage depletion, rapid water pan dry-downs, and adverse terms-of-trade degradation for rural households.`;
  } else {
    compoundBadgeClass = "compound-low";
    compoundingNarrative = `Analogue years display near-normal precipitation distribution. Agricultural and rangeland systems are expected to operate within standard seasonal envelopes without extreme cumulative moisture exhaustion or widespread inundation.`;
  }

  // 8. Historical Precedent Helper
  function getHistoricalImpact(year, cty, sea, terc, ptotVal, anomVal, gMap) {
    const gKey = `${year}_${sea}`;
    const g = gMap?.get(gKey);
    const yrStr = String(year);

    if (g && g.flooded_km2 > 15) {
      const floodKm = Math.round(g.flooded_km2).toLocaleString();
      const popExp = Math.round(g.pop_exposed).toLocaleString();
      return {
        text: `Copernicus Sentinel-1 SAR observed ${floodKm} km² inundated extent with ~${popExp} persons exposed in ${cty}. Riverine overflow and localized logistics chokepoint washouts.`,
        source: "Copernicus GFM Sentinel-1 SAR / GloFAS v2.1"
      };
    }

    const curated = {
      "1997": {
        text: "Catastrophic El Niño inundation; record rainfall across eastern & northern Kenya; major river breaches and severe infrastructure washouts.",
        source: "OCHA / EM-DAT Kenya Floods 1997"
      },
      "2023": {
        text: "Strong El Niño + positive IOD floods ending 2020–23 drought; major riverine floodplains inundated; road washouts along arterial transport corridors.",
        source: "Copernicus GFM Sentinel-1 SAR / NDMA 2023"
      },
      "2019": {
        text: "Super-IOD floods; widespread short rains inundation, recharging rangelands but triggering 2020 desert locust upsurge across northern ASALs.",
        source: "Copernicus GFM Sentinel-1 SAR / FAO 2019"
      },
      "2015": {
        text: "Strong El Niño; above-average rainfall across pastoral rangelands; substantial forage regeneration with localized transport disruptions.",
        source: "NDMA National Early Warning 2015"
      },
      "2006": {
        text: "Positive IOD / El Niño floods following 2005–06 drought; flash flooding and localized pastoral isolation in arid valleys.",
        source: "NDMA / OCHA 2006"
      },
      "1982": {
        text: "Major El Niño; unusually wet short rains across northern and eastern Kenya; abundant pasture regeneration.",
        source: "KMSA Historical Archives 1982"
      },
      "2021": {
        text: "La Niña failure; progressive soil moisture exhaustion, pasture collapse, and accelerating pastoral terms-of-trade degradation.",
        source: "NDMA Drought Early Warning 2021"
      },
      "2022": {
        text: "Protracted La Niña drought emergency; acute water pan depletion, severe rangeland biomass deficit, and emergency livestock feed distributions.",
        source: "NDMA Drought Bulletins 2022"
      },
      "2020": {
        text: "La Niña onset; below-normal rainfall leading to rapid pasture deterioration and early livestock migration.",
        source: "NDMA Early Warning 2020"
      },
      "2016": {
        text: "Weak La Niña failure; poor short rains culminating in February 2017 national drought disaster declaration.",
        source: "NDMA Drought Early Warning 2016"
      },
      "2010": {
        text: "Strong La Niña Horn of Africa drought; catastrophic pasture collapse, acute livestock mortality, and humanitarian emergency response.",
        source: "NDMA / FSNWG Horn of Africa Crisis 2010"
      },
      "2005": {
        text: "Borderline La Niña drought; severe pasture deficit in northern pastoral rangelands with sharp terms-of-trade decline.",
        source: "NDMA Drought Archive 2005"
      },
      "2018": {
        text: "Exceptional long rains floods; widespread riverine and lake basin inundation; severe infrastructure damage.",
        source: "Copernicus GFM SAR / OCHA Flash Update 2018"
      },
      "2024": {
        text: "Severe long rains riverine floods & Mai Mahiu dam breach; 281,000+ displaced, 267 fatalities nationally.",
        source: "ACAPS / Copernicus GFM SAR 2024"
      }
    };

    if (curated[yrStr]) {
      return curated[yrStr];
    }

    if (terc === "Wet") {
      return {
        text: `Elevated precipitation (${Math.round(ptotVal)} mm, +${Math.round(anomVal)}% anomaly); heightened surface runoff, soil saturation, and localized flash flooding risks.`,
        source: "CHIRPS v2.0 / KMSA Historical Archives"
      };
    } else if (terc === "Dry") {
      return {
        text: `Moisture deficit (${Math.round(ptotVal)} mm, ${Math.round(anomVal)}% anomaly); rangeland forage contraction, water pan stress, and heightened agricultural moisture deficit.`,
        source: "CHIRPS v2.0 / NDMA Drought Archive"
      };
    } else {
      return {
        text: `Near-normal precipitation (${Math.round(ptotVal)} mm, ${Math.round(anomVal)}% anomaly); typical baseline pasture productivity and standard crop cycle outcomes.`,
        source: "CHIRPS v2.0 WMO 1991–2020 Baseline"
      };
    }
  }

  // 9. Format Top 3 Precedent Cards
  const top3Dots = dots.slice(0, 3);
  const precedentCardsHTML = top3Dots.map((d, idx) => {
    const tercClass = (d.tercile || "Near").toLowerCase();
    const anomStr = (d.anomaly_pct != null) ? `${d.anomaly_pct > 0 ? '+' : ''}${Math.round(d.anomaly_pct)}%` : "N/A";
    const ptotStr = (d.ptot != null) ? `${Math.round(d.ptot)} mm` : "N/A";
    const impact = getHistoricalImpact(d.year, county, season, d.tercile, d.ptot || climMean, d.anomaly_pct || 0, gfmMap);

    return html`
      <div class="precedent-card">
        <div class="precedent-rank">
          <span>Rank #${idx + 1} &bull; ${d.year}</span>
          <span class="precedent-anom-badge ${tercClass}">${d.tercile} (${anomStr})</span>
        </div>
        <div style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #64748b; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 3px;">
          Observed Total: <strong style="color: #0f172a;">${ptotStr}</strong> (vs ${Math.round(climMean)} mm norm)
        </div>
        <p class="precedent-impact">${impact.text}</p>
        <div class="precedent-cite">
          <strong>Source:</strong> ${impact.source}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  });

  // 10. Multi-Sector Actions Matrix Checklists
  const isWetOutlook = modalCategory === "Wet";
  const isDryOutlook = modalCategory === "Dry";

  const agriChecklist = isWetOutlook ? [
    "Advise construction and reinforcement of soil terraces, contours, and water diversion furrows on sloping arable plots.",
    "Distribute certified early-maturing, water-logging tolerant seed cultivars 4 weeks prior to onset.",
    "Pre-position post-harvest hermetic storage bags and mobile grain drying units across agricultural cooperatives to mitigate high humidity and aflatoxin contamination in maize and pulses."
  ] : isDryOutlook ? [
    "Subsidize certified drought-escaping seed cultivars (sorghum, pearl millet, cowpeas, green grams) 4 weeks before onset.",
    "Promote in-situ rainwater harvesting, micro-basins, and heavy organic crop residue mulching for soil moisture retention.",
    "Advise farmers against late planting or over-reliance on moisture-demanding maize hybrids in marginal agro-ecological zones."
  ] : [
    "Promote standard certified crop seeds and timely land preparation.",
    "Maintain integrated pest management protocols and routine post-harvest handling.",
    "Encourage balanced rotational cropping and standard soil fertility management."
  ];

  const livestockChecklist = isWetOutlook ? [
    "Pre-position livestock vaccines and ring-vaccination biologics against vector-borne Rift Valley Fever (RVF) and CCPP prior to onset.",
    "Stockpile acaricides and vector control fly traps in rangeland pastoral basins.",
    "Designate elevated, well-drained pastoral grazing sanctuaries to protect herds against foot-rot."
  ] : isDryOutlook ? [
    "Activate early commercial destocking vouchers with Kenya Meat Commission (KMC) and local livestock traders before herd body condition deteriorates.",
    "Pre-position supplementary feed blocks, cottonseed cake, and drought mineral supplements at strategic pastoral distribution hubs.",
    "Establish emergency fuel subsidies and rapid repair kits for high-yield strategic community boreholes along livestock trekking corridors."
  ] : [
    "Routine disease surveillance and livestock vaccination across rangelands.",
    "Maintain standard seasonal rotational grazing and pasture deferment protocols.",
    "Routine monitoring of livestock body condition and terms of trade."
  ];

  const waterHealthChecklist = isWetOutlook ? [
    "Elevate shallow well intake heads and protect community borehole solar pump arrays above 100-year flood lines.",
    "Pre-position cholera treatment kits, oral rehydration salts (ORS), and household water purification chemicals (AquaTabs) across rural dispensaries.",
    "Desilt and widen stormwater drainage trunk canals in peri-urban settlement centers."
  ] : isDryOutlook ? [
    "Service emergency generators and submersible pumps on designated strategic drought reserve boreholes.",
    "Mobilize emergency water trucking bowsers for scheduled delivery to schools, health dispensaries, and remote pastoral encampments.",
    "Deepen and rehabilitate community earth pans and sand dams ahead of anticipated seasonal recharge."
  ] : [
    "Routine preventive maintenance on community water distribution infrastructure.",
    "Regular water quality testing and community hygiene promotion.",
    "Maintain strategic municipal water storage reserves."
  ];

  const drmChecklist = isWetOutlook ? [
    "Clear debris from bridge crossings, culverts, and drift causeways along key supply routes (e.g., A2 corridor, rural access feeder roads).",
    "Pre-position emergency non-food relief items (tarpaulins, mosquito nets, cooking sets) in flood-safe forward storage depots.",
    "Identify and gazette elevated community evacuation sanctuaries in coordination with the CDRMC and Kenya Red Cross Society."
  ] : isDryOutlook ? [
    "Scale up county emergency cash transfers and cash-for-work safety net programs (HSNP / social registries) to maintain household purchasing power.",
    "Convene monthly CDRMC inter-agency coordination meetings to monitor terms-of-trade degradation and rangeland biomass depletion.",
    "Activate county emergency contingency funding pursuant to the National Disaster Risk Management Act No. 16 of 2026."
  ] : [
    "Monthly monitoring of KMSA advisories by the County Disaster Risk Management Committee (CDRMC).",
    "Maintain standard county emergency contingency readiness and inter-agency roster.",
    "Periodic drills of early warning dissemination channels."
  ];

  // 11. Proposal Paragraph Text Generator
  const seasonFull = season === "OND" ? "Short Rains (October–December)" : "Long Rains (March–May)";
  const econContextText = isPastoral
    ? `pastoral and agro-pastoral livelihoods (with livestock comprising approximately ${(vopSummary?.pctLivestock || 85).toFixed(0)}% of modeled agricultural capital; MapSPAM/GLW4 nominal 2021 USD basis, excl. camels which represent dominant pastoral wealth in KNBS Census Vol IV)`
    : `smallholder cropping and mixed agricultural systems (with crops representing approximately ${(vopSummary?.pctCrops || 70).toFixed(0)}% of agricultural capital; MapSPAM/GLW4 nominal 2021 USD basis)`;

  const proposalParagraphText = `Climate Rationale Synthesis for ${county} County (${seasonFull}):
According to official Kenya National Bureau of Statistics (KNBS 2019 Census Vol IV) data, ${county} County encompasses an enumerated population of ${popStr} residents across ${areaStr} km². The county's rural economy is anchored in ${econContextText}. Under active equatorial ocean dynamics observed by NOAA CPC (antecedent JAS RONI of ${roniDisplay} °C and DMI of ${dmiDisplay} °C), empirical analogue analysis based on standardized Euclidean distance in joint ocean-temperature space indicates that ${topCount} of the ${n} nearest historical analogue seasons (${Math.round((topCount/n)*100)}% [95% CI: ${Math.round(ci.low*100)}%–${Math.round(ci.high*100)}%]) resulted in ${isWetOutlook ? "Above Normal (wetter than 1991–2020 WMO climatological baseline)" : isDryOutlook ? "Below Normal (drier than 1991–2020 WMO climatological baseline)" : "Near Normal"} rainfall, with an empirical mean anomaly of ${meanAnomPct > 0 ? "+" : ""}${Math.round(meanAnomPct)}% against the county 30-year normal (${Math.round(climMean)} mm).

In alignment with the National Disaster Risk Management Act No. 16 of 2026 and County Disaster Risk Management Committee (CDRMC) protocols, anticipatory adaptation financing is urgently justified to ${isWetOutlook ? "pre-position veterinary biologics against vector-borne livestock diseases (Rift Valley Fever, CCPP), reinforce vulnerable arterial transport culverts, and distribute water-logging tolerant certified crop varieties" : isDryOutlook ? "deploy strategic livestock feed supplements and destocking vouchers, service emergency borehole generators, and scale up social registry cash transfers" : "maintain standard agricultural inputs and livestock health surveillance"}. Operational weather advisories must be continuously coordinated through the Kenya Meteorological Service Authority (KMSA) under the Meteorology Act No. 7 of 2026.`;

  // 12. Build and Release Metadata
  const releaseVersion = releaseMeta?.versionDisplay || "v3.7.0";
  const releaseBuild = releaseMeta?.build ? `build ${releaseMeta.build}` : "build 61c3784";
  const releaseVintage = releaseMeta?.dataVintage || "2026-09";
  const generationDate = new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-KE", { year: "numeric", month: "long", day: "numeric" });

  // 13. Assemble Executive Brief DOM
  const briefEl = html`
    <div class="brief-wrapper">
      <!-- Screen-only top action bar -->

        <div class="brief-actions-right">

            <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><rect x="9" y="9" width="13" height="13" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M5 15H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v1"></path></svg>
            Copy Proposal Rationale
          </button>
          <button type="button" class="btn-print-brief" onclick="window.printExecutiveBrief ? window.printExecutiveBrief() : window.print()" title="Export or print clean 2-page PDF brief">
            <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><polyline points="6 9 6 2 18 2 18 9"></polyline><path d="M6 18H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h16a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-2"></path><rect x="6" y="14" width="12" height="8"></rect></svg>
            Export / Print 2-Page Brief
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- PAGE 1: DIAGNOSIS, PLANETARY SIGNALS & ANALOGUE CONSENSUS -->
      <div class="brief-page brief-page-1">
        <div class="brief-doc-header">
          <div class="brief-header-meta-row">
            <span>AFRICAN AGRICULTURE ADAPTATION ATLAS &bull; KENYA CLIMATE RATIONALE PLATFORM</span>
            <span style="color: #0284c7;">PAGE 1 OF 2 &bull; EXECUTIVE BRIEF</span>
          </div>
          <div class="brief-title-row">
            <h2 class="brief-doc-title">Executive Climate Brief: ${county} County</h2>
            <span class="brief-season-badge">${season === "OND" ? "OND Short Rains" : "MAM Long Rains"} Outlook</span>
          </div>
          <p class="brief-doc-subtitle">Empirical Planetary Ocean Dynamics, Historical Analogue Odds &amp; Operational Decision Precedents</p>
        </div>

        <!-- Administrative Baseline Strip -->
        <div class="brief-admin-strip">
          <div class="admin-col">
            <span class="lbl">County &amp; P-Code</span>
            <span class="val">${county} <small style="color:#64748b; font-weight:normal;">(${selPCode})</small></span>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-col">
            <span class="lbl">KNBS 2019 Census Headcount</span>
            <span class="val">${popStr} <small style="color:#64748b; font-weight:normal;">(${totalsPopStr} 2026 proj)</small></span>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-col">
            <span class="lbl">Land Area &amp; Density</span>

          </div>
          <div class="admin-col">
            <span class="lbl">Rural Economic Baseline</span>
            <span class="val" style="font-size: 0.76rem;">${econSummary}</span>

            <span class="val">OND: ${Math.round(climOND)} mm | MAM: ${Math.round(climMAM)} mm</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Four Diagnostic KPI Metric Tiles -->
        <div class="brief-kpi-grid">
          <!-- Tile 1: Ocean State -->
          <div class="brief-kpi-card kpi-ocean">
            <div class="kpi-card-header">

            <div class="kpi-main-metric">

                <span class="driver-label">NOAA CPC RONI (${currentState?.roniSeason || 'JAS 2026'}):</span>

          <!-- Tile 2: KMSA Mandate -->

              <span class="kpi-icon">🏛️</span>

              <span class="kpi-status-badge mandate">Official Voice</span>
            </div>
            <div class="kpi-main-metric">
              <div class="mandate-authority">Kenya Meteorological Service Authority (KMSA)</div>
            </div>
            <p class="kpi-desc">
              Mandated under <strong>Meteorology Act No. 7 of 2026</strong>. This platform provides empirical analogues for adaptation project design; binding operational daily weather warnings and seasonal advisories are issued exclusively by KMSA (<a href="https://meteo.go.ke" target="_blank" rel="noopener">meteo.go.ke</a>) and downscaled by the County Director of Meteorology (CDM).
            </p>
          </div>

          <!-- Tile 3: Analogue Consensus Odds -->
          <div class="brief-kpi-card kpi-consensus">
            <div class="kpi-card-header">
              <span class="kpi-icon">🎯</span>
              <span class="kpi-title">Analogue Consensus (${n} Nearest Seasons)</span>
              <span class="kpi-status-badge ${modalCategory.toLowerCase()}">${modalCategory} Odds</span>
            </div>
            <div class="kpi-main-metric">
              <div class="consensus-ratio">
                ${topCount} of ${n} seasons (${Math.round((topCount / n) * 100)}%) were ${modalCategory}
              </div>
              <div class="consensus-ci" style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px;">
                <span>95% Wilson CI: <strong>${Math.round(ci.low * 100)}%–${Math.round(ci.high * 100)}%</strong></span>
                ${skillRPSS ? html`<span class="hindcast-badge" style="font-size: 0.63rem; font-weight: 700; background: #e0f2fe; color: #0369a1; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #bae6fd;">LOOCV: RPSS ${skillRPSS} &bull; ${skillHitPct} Hit</span>` : ''}
              </div>
            </div>
            <p class="kpi-desc">
              Analogue rainfall averaged <strong>${Math.round(meanAnalogueRain)} mm</strong> (${meanAnomPct > 0 ? '+' : ''}${Math.round(meanAnomPct)}% vs county 1991–2020 normal: ${Math.round(climMean)} mm). Distribution: ${counts.Wet || 0} Above Normal (Wet), ${counts.Near || 0} Near Normal, ${counts.Dry || 0} Below Normal (Dry).
            </p>
          </div>

          <!-- Tile 4: Compounding Consecutive-Season Risk -->
          <div class="brief-kpi-card kpi-compounding">
            <div class="kpi-card-header">
              <span class="kpi-icon">🔄</span>
              <span class="kpi-title">Consecutive-Season Compounding Dynamics</span>
              <span class="kpi-status-badge ${compoundBadgeClass}">Compound Risk</span>
            </div>

            <p class="kpi-desc">${compoundingNarrative}</p>

        <!-- Section B: Top 3 Historical Analogue Precedents -->

            <h3 class="section-title">Top 3 Historical Ocean Analogue Precedents for ${county} County</h3>
            <span class="section-note">Ranked by standardized Euclidean distance in joint ocean-temperature space</span>
          </div>
          <div class="precedents-grid">

      <!-- Screen Page Break Indicator -->
      <div class="brief-page-break-screen brief-no-print">
        <div class="break-line"></div>
        <div class="break-pill">
          <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"></path><polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"></polyline></svg>
          Page 1 End &bull; 2-Page Print / PDF Boundary
        </div>
        <div class="break-line"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- PAGE 2: ANTICIPATORY ACTION MATRIX & PROPOSAL RATIONALE -->
      <div class="brief-page brief-page-2">
        <div class="brief-doc-header">
          <div class="brief-header-meta-row">

          </div>
          <div class="brief-title-row">
            <h2 class="brief-doc-title">Anticipatory Action Matrix: ${county} County</h2>
            <span class="brief-season-badge">Operational Leads</span>
          </div>
          <p class="brief-doc-subtitle">Multi-Sector Contingency Triggers Aligned with National Disaster Risk Management Act No. 16 of 2026 (CDRMC Framework)</p>
        </div>

        <!-- Multi-Sector Anticipatory Action Matrix (4 Sectors) -->
        <div class="brief-actions-matrix-grid">
          <!-- Sector 1: Agriculture -->
          <div class="action-sector-card">
            <div class="action-sector-header">
              <span class="sector-icon">🌾</span>
              <div class="sector-meta">
                <h4 class="sector-title">1. Agriculture &amp; Crop Production</h4>
                <span class="sector-lead">Lead: County Dept. of Agriculture / KALRO / AFA</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div class="trigger-label">Anticipatory Trigger (4–6 Weeks Pre-Onset):</div>
              <ul class="action-checklist">
                ${agriChecklist.map(item => html`<li>${item}</li>`)}
              </ul>
              <div class="sector-stake">
                <strong>Resource at Stake:</strong> $${cropVopUSD}M modeled crop capital (farmgate value; MapSPAM baseline) &amp; smallholder food security reserves.
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Sector 2: Livestock -->
          <div class="action-sector-card">
            <div class="action-sector-header">
              <span class="sector-icon">🐂</span>
              <div class="sector-meta">
                <h4 class="sector-title">2. Livestock, Rangeland &amp; Pasture</h4>
                <span class="sector-lead">Lead: County Dept. of Livestock &amp; Veterinary / NDMA County Office</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div class="trigger-label">Anticipatory Trigger:</div>
              <ul class="action-checklist">
                ${livestockChecklist.map(item => html`<li>${item}</li>`)}
              </ul>
              <div class="sector-stake">
                <strong>Resource at Stake:</strong> $${livestockVopUSD}M modeled livestock capital (excl. camels; nominal 2021 USD basis) plus official KNBS census herds (${camelNote}).
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Sector 3: Water & Health -->
          <div class="action-sector-card">
            <div class="action-sector-header">
              <span class="sector-icon">💧</span>
              <div class="sector-meta">
                <h4 class="sector-title">3. Water, Sanitation &amp; Public Health</h4>
                <span class="sector-lead">Lead: County Dept. of Water &amp; Public Health / Kenya Red Cross (KRCS)</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div class="trigger-label">Anticipatory Trigger:</div>
              <ul class="action-checklist">
                ${waterHealthChecklist.map(item => html`<li>${item}</li>`)}
              </ul>
              <div class="sector-stake">
                <strong>Resource at Stake:</strong> Public health protection, cholera outbreak prevention, and municipal water supply continuity.
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Sector 4: DRM & Logistics -->
          <div class="action-sector-card">
            <div class="action-sector-header">
              <span class="sector-icon">🛡️</span>
              <div class="sector-meta">
                <h4 class="sector-title">4. Disaster Risk Management &amp; Infrastructure</h4>
                <span class="sector-lead">Lead: County Disaster Risk Management Committee (CDRMC) / KeNHA / KURA</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div class="trigger-label">Anticipatory Trigger:</div>
              <ul class="action-checklist">
                ${drmChecklist.map(item => html`<li>${item}</li>`)}
              </ul>
              <div class="sector-stake">
                <strong>Resource at Stake:</strong> Critical road corridor passability (trunk logistics routes) and human settlement safety.
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Citable Proposal Climate Rationale Text Block -->
        <div class="brief-proposal-section">
          <div class="proposal-header">
            <span class="proposal-title">Citable Climate Rationale Paragraph (Ready for GCF / AF / CIDP Section B)</span>
            <button type="button" class="btn-copy-inline brief-no-print" onclick="window.copyBriefProposalText ? window.copyBriefProposalText() : null">
              <svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><rect x="9" y="9" width="13" height="13" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M5 15H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v1"></path></svg>
              Copy Rationale
            </button>
          </div>
          <div class="proposal-body">
            <p id="briefProposalText">${proposalParagraphText}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Official Provenance, Legal Sign-Off & Vintage -->
        <div class="brief-doc-footer">
          <div>
            <strong>Statutory &amp; Administrative Alignment:</strong> Kenya Meteorological Service Authority (Meteorology Act No. 7 of 2026) &bull; National Disaster Risk Management Act No. 16 of 2026 (CDRMC) &bull; KNBS 2019 Kenya Population &amp; Housing Census Volume IV &bull; KNBS National Agricultural Produce Reports (NAPR 2019–2024).
          </div>
          <div>
            <strong>Scientific Provenance:</strong> NOAA CPC ERSSTv6 / RONI &bull; CHIRPS v2.0 (1981–2025; WMO 1991–2020 30-year climatological normal) &bull; Copernicus GFM Sentinel-1 SAR &bull; JRC GloFAS River Flood Hazard Maps v2.1.
          </div>
          <div>
            <strong>Platform Release:</strong> ${releaseVersion} (${releaseBuild}) &bull; Data Vintage: ${releaseVintage} &bull; Generated: ${generationDate} &bull; African Agriculture Adaptation Atlas (Digital Atlas, CC BY 4.0).
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  host.replaceChildren(briefEl);
  return briefEl;
}
// ---- Figure 3.1 Controls & Visualization Machinery (ENSO-V3-041) ----
viewof rainTimeRes = Inputs.radio(["By year", "Monthly climatology"], {
  value: "By year",
  label: "Timeseries resolution:"
})
climateVar = "Precipitation"
viewof rainView = Inputs.radio(["Absolute rainfall", "Anomaly vs 1991–2020 normal"], {
  value: "Absolute rainfall",
  label: "Rainfall representation:"
})
viewof spreadOpt = Inputs.select(["None (county mean)", "Typical range (±1 sd, 68%)", "Full spread (±2 sd, 95%)"], {
  label: "Sub-county range bars:", value: "None (county mean)",
})
viewof stripMode = Inputs.radio(["Event phase (El Niño / La Niña)", "Driver intensity (heat gradient)", "Off"], {
  label: "Ocean driver marker strip:", value: "Event phase (El Niño / La Niña)",
})
viewof rainYearFrom = Inputs.number([1981, 2024], {value: 1981, step: 1, label: "From year:"})
viewof rainYearTo = Inputs.number([1981, 2024], {value: 2024, step: 1, label: "To year:"})
rainYears = [rainYearFrom, rainYearTo]
rainVarMeta = ({
  "Precipitation": {
    v: "PTOT", unit: "mm", short: "PTOT",
    anomDesc: "mm relative to 1991–2020 WMO standard normal",
    source: "CHIRPS v3 (UCSB/CHC)",
  },
  "Drought index (SPEI-3)": {
    v: "SPEI-03", unit: "z", short: "SPEI03",
    anomDesc: "Standardised Precipitation-Evapotranspiration Index (3-month)",
    source: "Vicente-Serrano / CHIRPS v3 derived",
  },
})

varDef = rainVarMeta[climateVar]
varShort = varDef.short
varIsSpei = varDef.v.startsWith("SPEI")
varIsTemp = varDef.v === "TMEAN"
varIsAnom = varIsSpei ? true : rainView.startsWith("Anomaly")

// Download payload: full dataset for the selected variable and year range
rainDownloadRows = {
  const rs = rainActiveSeasons.flatMap((s) => {
    const dataObj = rainSeasonData.get(s);
    if (!dataObj) return [];
    return dataObj.rows.map((r) => ({
      county,
      gaul1_code: selGaul,
      variable: climateVar,
      season: s,
      year: r.year,
      value: r.value,
      clim_1991_2020: dataObj.clim,
      anomaly: varIsSpei ? null : (r.value != null ? r.value - dataObj.clim : null),
      pixel_sd: r.sd,
      ocean_driver: s === "MAM" ? r.wnp : `${r.enso} / ${r.iodPhase}`,
    }));
  });
  return rs;
}

// Fetch seasonal totals for the selected county & year range from chirps_county
rainSeasonData = {
  const yrLo = Math.min(rainYearFrom, rainYearTo);
  const yrHi = Math.max(rainYearFrom, rainYearTo);
  const map = new Map();
  for (const s of rainActiveSeasons) {
    const rows = await dbChirps.query(`
      SELECT year,
             AVG(value_mean) AS val,
             AVG(value_sd)   AS sd
      FROM chirps_county
      WHERE ${normExpr("admin1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
        AND variable = '${varDef.v}'
        AND period = '${s}'
        AND year BETWEEN ${yrLo} AND ${yrHi}
      GROUP BY year
      ORDER BY year
    `);
    const climRows = await dbChirps.query(`
      SELECT AVG(value_mean) AS clim
      FROM chirps_county
      WHERE ${normExpr("admin1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
        AND variable = '${varDef.v}'
        AND period = '${s}'
        AND year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2020
    `);
    const clim = climRows[0] ? climRows[0].clim : (d3.mean(rows, (r) => r.val) || 0);
    const aug = rows.map((r) => {
      const enso = ensoPhaseOND.get(r.year) ?? "Neutral";
      const iodPhase = iodPhaseOND.get(r.year) ?? "Neutral";
      const wnp = wnpPhaseMAM.get(r.year) ?? "Neutral";
      return {year: r.year, value: r.val, sd: r.sd, enso, iodPhase, wnp};
    });
    map.set(s, {rows: aug, clim});
  }
  return map;
}

phaseChips = html``
rainPanel = (s) => {
  const dataObj = rainSeasonData.get(s);
  if (!dataObj) return html`<div style="color:#666;font-style:italic">Loading data for ${county} (${s})...</div>`;
  const {rows, clim} = dataObj;
  if (!rows.length) return html`<div style="color:#666;font-style:italic">No ${varDef.v} data for ${county} (${s}).</div>`;
  const anomaly = varIsSpei ? true : rainView.startsWith("Anomaly");

  // Baseline stats for absolute & anomaly thresholds (Empirical 1991–2020 quantiles, Defect 7)
  const climYears = rows.filter((r) => r.year >= 1991 && r.year <= 2020 && r.value != null);
  const climVals = climYears.map((r) => r.value).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const tMean = Math.round(clim);
  // Empirical quantiles over 1991–2020: terciles (P33, P67) and extreme bounds (P10, P90)
  const tP10 = Math.round(d3.quantile(climVals, 0.10) ?? Math.max(0, clim * 0.4));
  const tP33 = Math.round(d3.quantile(climVals, 1 / 3) ?? (clim * 0.7));
  const tP67 = Math.round(d3.quantile(climVals, 2 / 3) ?? (clim * 1.3));
  const tP90 = Math.round(d3.quantile(climVals, 0.90) ?? (clim * 1.6));

  const categoryOfAbs = (val) => {
    if (val >= tP90) return "Much wetter";
    if (val >= tP67) return "Wetter";
    if (val > tP33) return "Normal";
    if (val > tP10) return "Drier";
    return "Much drier";
  };

  const categoryOfVal = (val) => {
    if (!anomaly && !varIsSpei) return categoryOfAbs(val);
    if (varIsSpei) {
      return val >= 0.5 ? "Wetter than normal" : val <= -0.5 ? "Drier than normal" : "Near normal";
    }
    // Anomaly representation evaluated against empirical 1991–2020 terciles
    return val >= tP67 ? "Wetter than normal" : (val <= tP33 ? "Drier than normal" : "Near normal");
  };

  const data = rows.map((r) => ({...r,
    y: varIsSpei ? r.value : (anomaly ? r.value - clim : r.value),
    category: categoryOfVal(r.value)
  }));
  const twoUp = rainActiveSeasons.length > 1;
  const yrExtent = d3.extent(data, (d) => d.year);
  const yrDomain = d3.range(yrExtent[0], yrExtent[1] + 1);
  const W = Math.max(twoUp ? 420 : 860, Math.min(twoUp ? 540 : 920, yrDomain.length * (twoUp ? 13 : 20)));

  const isAbsMode = !anomaly && !varIsSpei;
  const outcomeDomain = isAbsMode
    ? ["Much wetter", "Wetter", "Normal", "Drier", "Much drier"]
    : ["Wetter than normal", "Near normal", "Drier than normal"];
  const outcomeRange = isAbsMode
    ? ["#1d4ed8", "#0ea5e9", "#94a3b8", "#f97316", "#b91c1c"]
    : [PALETTE.outcome.wetter, PALETTE.outcome.near, PALETTE.outcome.drier];
  const outcomeOf = (d) => d.category;
  const yLabel = varIsSpei ? "SPEI-3 (standardised)" : (anomaly ? "mm vs 1991–2020 normal" : "Rainfall (mm total)");
  const hasStrip = stripMode !== "Off";
  const spreadK = (spreadOpt && spreadOpt.includes("±1")) ? 1 : (spreadOpt && spreadOpt.includes("±2")) ? 2 : 0;
  const spreadMarks = (spreadK > 0 && !varIsSpei)
    ? [Plot.ruleX(data.filter((d) => d.sd != null), {x: "year",
        y1: (d) => (!anomaly) ? Math.max(0, d.y - spreadK * d.sd) : d.y - spreadK * d.sd,
        y2: (d) => d.y + spreadK * d.sd, stroke: "#334155", strokeWidth: 1,
        title: (d) => `±${spreadK} sd across county pixels (sd = ${Math.round(d.sd)} mm)`})]
    : [];

  const absRules = isAbsMode ? [
    Plot.ruleY([tMean], {stroke: "#334155", strokeDasharray: "4,4", strokeWidth: 1.3}),
    Plot.ruleY([tP90], {stroke: "#1d4ed8", strokeDasharray: "2,2", strokeWidth: 1, strokeOpacity: 0.8}),
    Plot.ruleY([tP67], {stroke: "#0ea5e9", strokeDasharray: "2,2", strokeWidth: 1, strokeOpacity: 0.8}),
    Plot.ruleY([tP33], {stroke: "#f97316", strokeDasharray: "2,2", strokeWidth: 1, strokeOpacity: 0.8}),
    Plot.ruleY([tP10], {stroke: "#b91c1c", strokeDasharray: "2,2", strokeWidth: 1, strokeOpacity: 0.8}),
    Plot.text([tMean], {
      x: () => yrDomain[yrDomain.length - 1], y: () => tMean,
      textAnchor: "start", dx: 6, text: () => `Normal Mean (${tMean} mm)`,
      fill: "#334155", fontSize: 8.5, fontWeight: 700
    }),
    Plot.text([tP90], {
      x: () => yrDomain[yrDomain.length - 1], y: () => tP90,
      textAnchor: "start", dx: 6, text: () => `Much Wetter: ≥${tP90} mm (P90)`,
      fill: "#1d4ed8", fontSize: 8, fontWeight: 600
    }),
    Plot.text([tP67], {
      x: () => yrDomain[yrDomain.length - 1], y: () => tP67,
      textAnchor: "start", dx: 6, text: () => `Wetter: ≥${tP67} mm (P67)`,
      fill: "#0ea5e9", fontSize: 8, fontWeight: 600
    }),
    Plot.text([tP33], {
      x: () => yrDomain[yrDomain.length - 1], y: () => tP33,
      textAnchor: "start", dx: 6, text: () => `Drier: ≤${tP33} mm (P33)`,
      fill: "#f97316", fontSize: 8, fontWeight: 600
    }),
    Plot.text([tP10], {
      x: () => yrDomain[yrDomain.length - 1], y: () => tP10,
      textAnchor: "start", dx: 6, text: () => `Much Drier: ≤${tP10} mm (P10)`,
      fill: "#b91c1c", fontSize: 8, fontWeight: 600
    })
  ] : [Plot.ruleY([0])];

  const main = Plot.plot({
    height: 310, width: W, marginLeft: 55, marginRight: isAbsMode ? 145 : 20, marginBottom: hasStrip ? 4 : 32,
    x: {domain: yrDomain, axis: hasStrip ? null : "bottom",
        tickFormat: (d) => String(d).slice(-2), label: null, nice: false,
        ticks: data.map((d) => d.year).filter((y) => y % 5 === 0)},
    y: {label: yLabel},
    color: {domain: outcomeDomain, range: outcomeRange, legend: !twoUp || s === "OND"},
    marks: [
      Plot.barY(data, {x: "year", y: "y", fill: outcomeOf,
        fillOpacity: (d) => (similarHighlightActive && similarYearsSet.size > 0)
          ? (similarYearsSet.has(d.year) ? 1.0 : 0.22)
          : 1.0,
        stroke: (d) => (similarHighlightActive && similarYearsSet.has(d.year)) ? "#0f172a" : "none",
        strokeWidth: (d) => (similarHighlightActive && similarYearsSet.has(d.year)) ? 1.8 : 0,
        channels: {Year: {value: (d) => String(d.year), label: "Year"},
          Value: {value: (d) => `${Math.round(d.value * 100) / 100} ${varDef.unit}`, label: climateVar},
          "Classification": {value: (d) => `${d.category}`},
          "Vs normal": {value: (d) => varIsSpei ? "—" : `${d.y >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${Math.round(d.value - clim)} mm`, label: "vs 1991–2020"},
          Ocean: {value: (d) => s === "MAM" ? d.wnp : `${d.enso} · ${d.iodPhase}`, label: "Ocean state"}},
        tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Year: true, Value: true, Classification: true, "Vs normal": true, Ocean: true}}}),
      ...spreadMarks,
      ...absRules,
    ],
  });

  // Season-specific Clickable Empirical Chips placed directly under heading
  const isMAM = s === "MAM";
  const chipGroups = isMAM
    ? [{key: "wnp", p: "Western-V high"}, {key: "wnp", p: "Western-V low"}]
    : [{key: "enso", p: "El Niño"}, {key: "enso", p: "La Niña"},
       {key: "iodPhase", p: "IOD positive"}, {key: "iodPhase", p: "IOD negative"}];

  const chips = chipGroups.map(({key, p}) => {
    const sub = rows.filter((r) => r[key] === p);
    if (sub.length < 3) return null;
    const m = d3.mean(sub, (r) => r.value);
    const dev = m - clim;
    const col = dev >= 0 ? PALETTE.outcome.wetter : PALETTE.outcome.drier;
    const lbl = varIsSpei ? m.toFixed(2) : `${dev >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${Math.round(dev)} mm`;
    const isPressed = similarHighlightActive && activePhaseHighlight === p;

    return html`<button type="button" class="enso-empirical-chip" role="button" aria-pressed="${isPressed ? 'true' : 'false'}"
      onclick="window.togglePhaseHighlight('${p}')"
      style="cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; margin: 2px 6px 4px 0; padding: 3px 9px; border: 1.5px solid ${isPressed ? '#0284c7' : '#cbd5e1'}; background: ${isPressed ? '#f0f9ff' : '#ffffff'}; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 11.5px; transition: all 0.15s ease; box-shadow: ${isPressed ? '0 0 0 2px rgba(2,132,199,0.2)' : 'none'};">
      <span style="font-weight: 600; color: #334155; margin-right: 4px;">${p}:</span>
      <b style="color: ${col};">${varIsSpei ? "SPEI " + lbl : lbl + " vs normal"}</b>
      <span style="color: #94a3b8; margin-left: 5px; font-size: 10.5px;">(${sub.length} yrs)</span>
    </button>`;
  }).filter(Boolean);

  const chipsBar = chips.length ? html`
    <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; align-items: center; margin: 0.25rem 0 0.5rem 0;">
      <span style="font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; color: #64748b; text-transform: uppercase; margin-right: 4px;">Click to highlight analogue seasons:</span>
      ${chips}
    </div>
  ` : "";

  let stripEl = html``;
  if (hasStrip) {
    const isDiscrete = !stripMode.includes("intensity") && !stripMode.startsWith("Strength");
    const cellColors = (d) => {
      if (s === "MAM") {
        const ph = d.wnp;
        return ph === "Western-V high" ? PALETTE.phase.wnpHigh : ph === "Western-V low" ? PALETTE.phase.wnpLow : "#ffffff";
      }
      const ph = d.enso;
      return ph === "El Niño" ? PALETTE.phase.elnino : ph === "La Niña" ? PALETTE.phase.lanina : "#ffffff";
    };
    const stripPlot = Plot.plot({
      height: 38, width: W, marginLeft: 55, marginRight: isAbsMode ? 145 : 20, marginTop: 0, marginBottom: 28,
      x: {domain: yrDomain, axis: "bottom", tickFormat: (d) => String(d).slice(-2), label: null,
          ticks: data.map((d) => d.year).filter((y) => y % 5 === 0)},
      marks: [
        Plot.cell(data, {x: "year", fill: isDiscrete ? cellColors : (d) => stripCardColor(driverValueFor(s === "MAM" ? "Western-V (WNP)" : "ENSO (RONI)", s, d.year)),
          stroke: "#cbd5e1", strokeWidth: 0.5,
          channels: {Year: {value: (d) => String(d.year)}, Ocean: {value: (d) => s === "MAM" ? d.wnp : `${d.enso} · ${d.iodPhase}`}},
          tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Year: true, Ocean: true}}}),
      ],
    });
    stripEl = html`<div style="margin-top: -2px;">${stripPlot}</div>`;
  }

  return html`
    <div class="rain-panel" style="min-width: ${twoUp ? 420 : 860}px; flex: 1 1 ${twoUp ? 420 : 860}px;">
      <div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 2px; color: #0f172a;">
        ${seasonWord(s)} (${s}) &bull; Climatological Normal (1991–2020): ${tMean} ${varDef.unit}
      </div>
      ${chipsBar}
      <div>${main}</div>
      ${stripEl}
    </div>
  `;
}
dbChirpsMonthly = DuckDBClient.of({
  chirps_monthly: FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/chirps_county_monthly.parquet"),
})

rainMonthlyRaw = dbChirpsMonthly.query(`
  SELECT month,
         AVG(ptot) AS clim,
         STDDEV(ptot) AS sd,
         MIN(ptot) AS min_val,
         MAX(ptot) AS max_val
  FROM chirps_monthly
  WHERE ${normExpr("county")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
    AND year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2020
  GROUP BY month
  ORDER BY month
`)

rainMonthlyClim = {
  const mNames = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"];
  return rainMonthlyRaw.map((r) => {
    const s = [3, 4, 5].includes(r.month) ? "MAM" : [10, 11, 12].includes(r.month) ? "OND" : "Other";
    return {...r, name: mNames[r.month - 1], season: s};
  });
}

rainMonthlyChart = {
  const data = rainMonthlyClim;
  if (!data.length) return html`<div style="color:#666">Loading monthly climatology...</div>`;
  return Plot.plot({
    height: 310, width: 860, marginLeft: 55, marginRight: 20, marginBottom: 35,
    x: {domain: data.map((d) => d.name), label: null},
    y: {label: "Rainfall (mm/month)"},
    color: {domain: ["MAM", "OND", "Other"], range: ["#16a34a", "#0284c7", "#94a3b8"],
            legend: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([0]),
      Plot.barY(data, {x: "name", y: "clim", fill: "season",
        channels: {Month: "name", Mean: (d) => `${Math.round(d.clim)} mm`,
          "1991–2020 ±1 sd": (d) => d.sd ? `±${Math.round(d.sd)} mm` : "—",
          Range: (d) => `${Math.round(d.min_val)}–${Math.round(d.max_val)} mm`},
        tip: {format: {x: false, y: false, fill: false, Month: true, Mean: true, "1991–2020 ±1 sd": true, Range: true}}}),
      Plot.ruleX(data.filter((d) => d.sd != null), {
        x: "name", y1: (d) => Math.max(0, d.clim - d.sd), y2: (d) => d.clim + d.sd,
        stroke: "#334155", strokeWidth: 1.5,
      }),
    ],
  });
}
// ---- Figure 3.2 Contingency Probability Matrix Machinery (ENSO-V3-042) ----
viewof contOndDriver = Inputs.radio(["ENSO (RONI)", "IOD (DMI)"], {
  value: "ENSO (RONI)",
  label: "OND Driver:"
})
viewof contMamDriver = Inputs.radio(["Western-V (WNP)", "ENSO (RONI)"], {
  value: "Western-V (WNP)",
  label: "MAM Driver:"
})
viewof contDetail = Inputs.radio(["Summary (3 groups)", "Detailed (5 groups)"], {
  value: "Summary (3 groups)",
  label: "Driver bins:"
})
viewof contShape = Inputs.radio(["Stacked shares (100%)", "Frequency counts (years)"], {
  value: "Stacked shares (100%)",
  label: "Plot representation:"
})
viewof contYearFrom = Inputs.number([1981, 2024], {value: 1981, step: 1, label: "From year:"})
viewof contYearTo = Inputs.number([1981, 2024], {value: 2024, step: 1, label: "To year:"})
contYears = [contYearFrom, contYearTo]
contRows = (season, drvName) => {
  const yrLo = Math.min(contYearFrom, contYearTo);
  const yrHi = Math.max(contYearFrom, contYearTo);
  const def = phaseDefs[drvName];
  if (!def) return {out: [], nAll: 0, groups: []};
  const is5 = contDetail.startsWith("Detailed");

  const rows = outlookBase.filter((r) =>
    r.season === season &&
    r.gaul1_code === selGaul &&
    r.year >= yrLo && r.year <= yrHi &&
    r.tercile != null
  );
  const nAll = rows.length;
  if (!nAll) return {out: [], nAll: 0, groups: []};

  const getZ = (y) => {
    if (drvName === "ENSO (RONI)") return (season === "MAM" ? roniZMam : roniZOnd).get(y);
    const m = zSeries(drvName, season);
    return m ? m.get(y) : null;
  };

  const classify = (z) => {
    if (z == null || Number.isNaN(z)) return null;
    if (is5) {
      if (z >= 1.5) return `Strong ${def.pos}`;
      if (z >= 0.5) return `Moderate ${def.pos}`;
      if (z > -0.5) return "Neutral";
      if (z > -1.5) return `Moderate ${def.neg}`;
      return `Strong ${def.neg}`;
    }
    if (z >= 0.5) return def.pos;
    if (z <= -0.5) return def.neg;
    return "Neutral";
  };

  const groups5 = [`Strong ${def.pos}`, `Moderate ${def.pos}`, "Neutral", `Moderate ${def.neg}`, `Strong ${def.neg}`];
  const groups3 = [def.pos, "Neutral", def.neg];
  const groups = is5 ? groups5 : groups3;

  const counts = new Map();
  for (const g of groups) counts.set(g, {Wetter: 0, "Near-normal": 0, Drier: 0, total: 0});

  const classifiedRows = [];
  for (const r of rows) {
    const z = getZ(r.year);
    const g = classify(z);
    if (!g || !counts.has(g)) continue;
    const bucket = counts.get(g);
    const oc = r.tercile === "Wet" ? "Wetter" : r.tercile === "Dry" ? "Drier" : "Near-normal";
    bucket[oc] = (bucket[oc] || 0) + 1;
    bucket.total = (bucket.total || 0) + 1;
    classifiedRows.push({...r, driverGroup: g, driverZ: z, outcome: oc});
  }

  const out = [];
  for (const g of groups) {
    const b = counts.get(g);
    const tot = b.total;
    for (const oc of ["Wetter", "Near-normal", "Drier"]) {
      const k = b[oc] || 0;
      out.push({
        season, driver: drvName, group: g, outcome: oc,
        count: k, total: tot,
        share: tot > 0 ? k / tot : null,
        pct: tot > 0 ? `${Math.round((k / tot) * 100)}%` : "—",
        small: tot < 5,
      });
    }
  }
  return {out, nAll, groups, rows: classifiedRows};
}

contingencyPanel = (season, drvName, opts = {}) => {
  const {out, nAll, groups} = contRows(season, drvName);
  if (!out.length) return html`<div style="color:#666">No record for ${county} (${season}).</div>`;
  const isShares = contShape.startsWith("Stacked");
  const outcomes = ["Wetter", "Near-normal", "Drier"];
  const outcomeColors = [PALETTE.outcome.wetter, PALETTE.outcome.near, PALETTE.outcome.drier];

  const yDomain = [...groups].reverse();
  const def = phaseDefs[drvName];

  return Plot.plot({
    height: Math.max(160, groups.length * 36 + 40),
    width: opts.width || 480,
    marginLeft: opts.marginLeft || 165,
    marginRight: opts.marginRight || 70,
    marginTop: 10,
    marginBottom: 35,
    x: isShares
      ? {
          domain: [0, 1],
          label: "Tercile share",
          ticks: [0, 0.333, 0.5, 0.667, 1],
          tickFormat: (d) => `${Math.round(d * 100)}%`
        }
      : {label: "Seasons (years)", nice: true},
    y: {domain: yDomain, label: null},
    color: {domain: outcomes, range: outcomeColors, legend: false},
    marks: [
      isShares ? Plot.ruleX([0.333], {stroke: "#334155", strokeDasharray: "3,3", strokeWidth: 1.2}) : null,
      isShares
        ? Plot.barX(out, {
            y: "group", x: "share", fill: "outcome", order: outcomes,
            channels: {
              Driver: "driver", Group: "group", Outcome: "outcome",
              Count: (d) => `${d.count} of ${d.total} yrs`,
              Share: (d) => d.pct,
              Advisory: (d) => d.small ? "Small sample (n < 5)" : "Sample OK"
            },
            tip: {format: {y: true, x: false, fill: false, Driver: true, Group: true, Outcome: true, Count: true, Share: true, Advisory: true}}
          })
        : Plot.barX(out, {
            y: "group", x: "count", fill: "outcome", order: outcomes,
            channels: {
              Driver: "driver", Group: "group", Outcome: "outcome",
              Count: (d) => `${d.count} yrs`,
              Share: (d) => d.pct,
              Advisory: (d) => d.small ? "Small sample (n < 5)" : "Sample OK"
            },
            tip: {format: {y: true, x: true, fill: false, Driver: true, Group: true, Outcome: true, Count: true, Share: true, Advisory: true}}
          }),
      Plot.text(
        out.filter((d) => d.outcome === "Wetter"),
        {
          y: "group",
          x: (d) => isShares ? 1 : d.total,
          textAnchor: "start",
          dx: 6,
          text: (d) => `n=${d.total}`,
          fill: (d) => d.small ? "#b45309" : "#64748b",
          fontSize: 11,
          fontWeight: (d) => d.small ? "700" : "400",
        }
      ),
    ].filter(Boolean)
  });
}

insightB2 = {
  const sel = activeSeason === "OND" ? contOndDriver : contMamDriver;
  const {out, nAll, rows: classifiedRows} = contRows(activeSeason, sel);
  if (!out.length) return html`<div style="color:#666">No historical records for ${county} (${activeSeason}).</div>`;
  const posName = phaseDefs[sel]?.pos ?? "positive";
  const posGroups = out.filter((d) => d.group.includes(posName));
  const n = d3.sum(posGroups, (d) => d.count);
  if (!n) {
    return html`<div class="figure-caption" style="margin-top:0.4rem; font-size: 0.82rem; color: #64748b;">
      Baseline record: <strong>${nAll} historical seasons</strong> across 1981–2024. No ${posName} seasons observed under current filtering.
    </div>`;
  }
  const cWet = d3.sum(posGroups.filter((d) => d.outcome === "Wetter"), (d) => d.count);
  const cNear = d3.sum(posGroups.filter((d) => d.outcome === "Near-normal"), (d) => d.count);
  const cDry = d3.sum(posGroups.filter((d) => d.outcome === "Drier"), (d) => d.count);
  
  let topOutcome = "Wetter";
  let cTop = cWet;
  if (cDry > cTop) { topOutcome = "Drier"; cTop = cDry; }
  if (cNear > cTop) { topOutcome = "Near-normal"; cTop = cNear; }
  
  const pct = Math.round((cTop / n) * 100);
  const sampleAdvisory = n < 5 ? html`<span style="margin-left: 6px; font-size: 0.74rem; background: #fffbeb; color: #b45309; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #fef08a;">Small sample size (n = ${n} seasons)</span>` : "";

  const posRows = (classifiedRows || []).filter((r) => r.driverGroup && r.driverGroup.includes(posName));
  const meanAnom = d3.mean(posRows, (d) => d.anomaly_pct);
  const sdAnom = d3.deviation(posRows, (d) => d.anomaly_pct);
  const anomStr = meanAnom != null && !isNaN(meanAnom)
    ? ` &bull; Mean anomaly: <strong>${meanAnom >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${meanAnom.toFixed(1)}%${sdAnom != null && !isNaN(sdAnom) ? ` (&plusmn;${sdAnom.toFixed(1)}%)` : ""}</strong> vs 1991&ndash;2020 normal`
    : "";

  return html`
    <div style="background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.65rem 0.95rem; font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.5; color: #334155;">
      <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 2px;">
        <strong style="color: #0f172a;">Empirical Teleconnection Frequency:</strong>
        ${sampleAdvisory}
      </div>
      During ${posName} conditions (${seasonWord(activeSeason)}), <strong>${cTop}/${n} (${pct}%)</strong> resulted in <strong>${topOutcome}</strong> conditions${anomStr}.
    </div>
  `;
}
// ---- Figure 3.3: Oceanic Driver Teleconnection Relationships (Scatter & Regression) (ENSO-V3-043) ----
viewof sec23Metric = Inputs.radio(
  ["Rainfall Anomaly (%)", "Total Rainfall (mm)", "Drought Index (SPEI-3)"],

)
viewof sec23Season = Inputs.radio(

  {value: activeSeason === "MAM" ? "MAM (Long Rains)" : "OND (Short Rains)", label: "Season:"}
)
sec23SeasonCode = sec23Season.startsWith("MAM") ? "MAM" : "OND"
viewof sec23Driver = Inputs.select(
  sec23SeasonCode === "OND"
    ? ["ENSO (RONI)", "IOD (DMI)", "ENSO + IOD"]
    : ["Western-V (WNP)", "ENSO (RONI)", "IOD (DMI)"],
  {value: sec23SeasonCode === "OND" ? "ENSO (RONI)" : "Western-V (WNP)", label: "Ocean Driver:"}
)

// Mount Figure 3.3 Controls to sec23ScatterControlsHost
{
  [sec23Metric, sec23Season, sec23Driver];
  const host = document.getElementById("sec23ScatterControlsHost");
  if (host) {
    host.replaceChildren(
      html`<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.85rem 1.5rem; align-items: center; width: 100%;">

        <div>${viewof sec23Metric}</div>
      </div>`
    );

}
sec23CandidateDrivers = {
  const isMAM = sec23SeasonCode === "MAM";
  const driverList = isMAM
    ? [
        {name: "Western-V (WNP)", basin: "Western North Pacific", code: "WNP"},
        {name: "ENSO (RONI)", basin: "Equatorial Pacific", code: "RONI"},
        {name: "IOD (DMI)", basin: "Equatorial Indian Ocean", code: "DMI"},
      ]
    : [
        {name: "ENSO (RONI)", basin: "Equatorial Pacific", code: "RONI"},
        {name: "IOD (DMI)", basin: "Equatorial Indian Ocean", code: "DMI"},
        {name: "ENSO + IOD", basin: "Joint Equatorial (Pacific + Indian)", code: "JOINT"},
      ];

  const rows = await dbChirps.query(`
    SELECT year, value_mean AS val
    FROM chirps_county
    WHERE ${normExpr("admin1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
      AND variable = 'PTOT'
      AND period = '${sec23SeasonCode}'
      AND year BETWEEN 1981 AND 2024
    ORDER BY year
  `);

  const results = [];
  for (const drv of driverList) {
    const pairs = [];
    for (const r of rows) {
      const y = r.year;
      let dVal = null;
      if (drv.code === "RONI") {
        dVal = isMAM ? (roniRawMam.get(y) ?? rawSeasonMean("roni", "MAM", y)) : (roniRawOnd.get(y) ?? rawSeasonMean("roni", "OND", y));
      } else if (drv.code === "DMI") {
        dVal = rawSeasonMean("dmi_hadisst", sec23SeasonCode, y);
      } else if (drv.code === "WNP") {
        dVal = rawSeasonMean("wnp_std_mam", sec23SeasonCode, y);
      } else if (drv.code === "JOINT") {
        const e = (roniRawOnd.get(y) ?? rawSeasonMean("roni", "OND", y) ?? 0);
        const i = rawSeasonMean("dmi_hadisst", "OND", y) || 0;
        dVal = (e + i) / 2;
      }
      if (dVal != null && !Number.isNaN(dVal)) {
        pairs.push({x: dVal, y: r.val});
      }
    }
    const n = pairs.length;
    if (n < 5) {
      results.push({...drv, r: 0, r2: 0, p: 1, n, utility: "Insufficient data"});
      continue;
    }
    const mx = d3.mean(pairs, d => d.x), my = d3.mean(pairs, d => d.y);
    const cov = d3.sum(pairs, d => (d.x - mx) * (d.y - my));
    const varX = d3.sum(pairs, d => (d.x - mx) ** 2);
    const varY = d3.sum(pairs, d => (d.y - my) ** 2);
    const r = (varX > 0 && varY > 0) ? cov / Math.sqrt(varX * varY) : 0;
    const r2 = r * r;
    const tStat = Math.abs(r) < 1 ? r * Math.sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - r2)) : 99;
    const pVal = Math.abs(tStat) > 3.5 ? 0.001 : Math.abs(tStat) > 2.7 ? 0.01 : Math.abs(tStat) > 2.0 ? 0.05 : 0.2;

    let utility = "Weak Teleconnection (p > 0.05)";
    if (pVal <= 0.05) {
      if (Math.abs(r) >= 0.5) utility = "Primary Teleconnection Driver";
      else if (Math.abs(r) >= 0.3) utility = "Moderate Predictive Utility";
      else utility = "Marginal Teleconnection";
    }

    results.push({...drv, r, r2, p: pVal, n, utility});
  }

  results.sort((a, b) => Math.abs(b.r) - Math.abs(a.r));
  return results;
}

// Render Candidate Driver Comparison Table

                </td>

                <td>
                  <span style="font-size: 0.78rem; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 600; background: ${d.utility.includes('Primary') ? '#dcfce7' : d.utility.includes('Moderate') ? '#e0f2fe' : '#f1f5f9'}; color: ${d.utility.includes('Primary') ? '#15803d' : d.utility.includes('Moderate') ? '#0369a1' : '#64748b'};">
                    ${d.utility}
                  </span>
                </td>
              </tr>
            `)}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}

// Mount Candidate Driver Comparison Table
{
  [county, sec23SeasonCode, sec23DriverTableRender];
  const host = document.getElementById("sec23DriverTableHost");
  if (host && sec23DriverTableRender) {
    host.replaceChildren(sec23DriverTableRender);

}
sec23Data = {
  const isSpeiMetric = sec23Metric.includes("SPEI");
  const varCode = isSpeiMetric ? "SPEI-03" : "PTOT";
  const rows = await dbChirps.query(`
    SELECT year, value_mean AS val
    FROM chirps_county
    WHERE ${normExpr("admin1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
      AND variable = '${varCode}'
      AND period = '${sec23SeasonCode}'
      AND year BETWEEN 1981 AND 2024
    ORDER BY year
  `);
  
  const refVals = rows.filter(r => r.year >= 1991 && r.year <= 2020).map(r => r.val);
  const climMean = refVals.length ? d3.mean(refVals) : (rows[0]?.val || 100);

  const joined = [];
  for (const r of rows) {
    const y = r.year;
    let dVal = null;
    if (sec23Driver === "ENSO (RONI)") {
      dVal = sec23SeasonCode === "OND" ? (roniRawOnd.get(y) ?? rawSeasonMean("roni", "OND", y) ?? rawSeasonMean("nino34_anom_noaa", "OND", y)) : (roniRawMam.get(y) ?? rawSeasonMean("roni", "MAM", y) ?? rawSeasonMean("nino34_anom_noaa", "MAM", y));
    } else if (sec23Driver === "IOD (DMI)") {
      dVal = rawSeasonMean("dmi_hadisst", sec23SeasonCode, y);
    } else if (sec23Driver === "Western-V (WNP)") {
      dVal = rawSeasonMean("wnp_std_mam", sec23SeasonCode, y);
    } else if (sec23Driver === "ENSO + IOD") {
      const e = (sec23SeasonCode === "OND" ? roniRawOnd.get(y) : roniRawMam.get(y)) ?? rawSeasonMean("roni", sec23SeasonCode, y) ?? rawSeasonMean("nino34_anom_noaa", sec23SeasonCode, y) ?? 0;
      const i = rawSeasonMean("dmi_hadisst", "OND", y) || 0;
      dVal = (e + i) / 2;
    }

    if (dVal == null || Number.isNaN(dVal)) continue;

    let yVal;
    if (sec23Metric === "Total Rainfall (mm)") {
      yVal = r.val;
    } else if (sec23Metric === "Rainfall Anomaly (%)") {
      yVal = climMean > 0 ? ((r.val - climMean) / climMean) * 100 : 0;
    } else {
      yVal = r.val;
    }

    joined.push({
      year: y,
      x: dVal,
      y: yVal
    });
  }

  // Calculate tercile classifications from 1991–2020 climatological baseline (Defect 7 & Audit D6)
  const baselineJoined = joined.filter(d => d.year >= 1991 && d.year <= 2020);
  const baseYVals = (baselineJoined.length >= 10 ? baselineJoined : joined).map(d => d.y).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const q33 = d3.quantile(baseYVals, 1 / 3);
  const q67 = d3.quantile(baseYVals, 2 / 3);

  joined.forEach(d => {
    d.outcome = d.y >= q67 ? "Wetter" : (d.y <= q33 ? "Drier" : "Near-normal");
    d.color = d.outcome === "Wetter" ? (PALETTE?.outcome?.wetter || "#2b83ba") : (d.outcome === "Drier" ? (PALETTE?.outcome?.drier || "#d7191c") : (PALETTE?.outcome?.near || "#94a3b8"));
  });

  // Identify notable benchmark years to label by default (top 3 wettest, top 3 driest, top 2 strongest driver departures)
  const sortedByY = [...joined].sort((a, b) => b.y - a.y);
  const sortedByAbsX = [...joined].sort((a, b) => Math.abs(b.x) - Math.abs(a.x));
  const benchmarkYears = new Set([
    ...sortedByY.slice(0, 3).map(d => d.year),
    ...sortedByY.slice(-3).map(d => d.year),
    ...sortedByAbsX.slice(0, 2).map(d => d.year)
  ]);

  joined.forEach(d => {
    d.isBenchmark = benchmarkYears.has(d.year);
  });

  // Calculate Pearson r, R², and OLS regression
  const n = joined.length;
  if (n < 3) return {points: [], r: 0, r2: 0, slope: 0, intercept: 0, pVal: 1, trendLine: []};

  const mx = d3.mean(joined, d => d.x);
  const my = d3.mean(joined, d => d.y);
  const cov = d3.sum(joined, d => (d.x - mx) * (d.y - my));
  const varX = d3.sum(joined, d => (d.x - mx) ** 2);
  const varY = d3.sum(joined, d => (d.y - my) ** 2);

  const r = (varX > 0 && varY > 0) ? cov / Math.sqrt(varX * varY) : 0;
  const r2 = r * r;
  const slope = varX > 0 ? cov / varX : 0;
  const intercept = my - slope * mx;

  const tStat = Math.abs(r) < 1 ? r * Math.sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - r2)) : 99;
  const pVal = Math.abs(tStat) > 3.5 ? 0.001 : Math.abs(tStat) > 2.7 ? 0.01 : Math.abs(tStat) > 2.0 ? 0.05 : 0.2;

  const xExtent = d3.extent(joined, d => d.x);
  const trendLine = [
    {x: xExtent[0], y: slope * xExtent[0] + intercept},
    {x: xExtent[1], y: slope * xExtent[1] + intercept}
  ];

  return {points: joined, r, r2, slope, intercept, pVal, trendLine, n};
}

// Stats Callout
{

        <div><strong>Variance Explained (R²):</strong> <span style="font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;">${Math.round(r2 * 100)}%</span></div>
        <div><strong>Significance:</strong> <span style="font-weight: 600; color: ${pVal <= 0.05 ? '#166534' : '#b45309'};">${pText}</span></div>
        <div style="color: #64748b; font-size: 0.76rem; margin-left: auto;">Sample: ${n} historical seasons (1981–2024)</div>
      </div>`
    );
  }
}

          "County Rainfall Response": d => `${d.y >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.y.toFixed(1)}${sec23Metric.includes('%') ? '%' : ''}`
        },

      }),
      Plot.text(d.points.filter(p => isFiltering ? similarYearsSet.has(p.year) : p.isBenchmark), {
        x: "x", y: "y",
        text: d => String(d.year),
        dy: -9,
        fontSize: 10,
        fontWeight: "bold",
        fill: "#0f172a"
      })
    ]
  });

  return html`
    <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 100%;">
      <!-- Visual Legend Bar -->
      <div style="display: flex; gap: 1rem; align-items: center; font-size: 0.78rem; color: #475569; background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 0.45rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 6px; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
        <span style="font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;">Rainfall Outcome (Terciles):</span>
        <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">
          <span style="width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #2b83ba; display: inline-block;"></span>
          <strong>Wetter</strong> (top 33%)
        </span>
        <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">
          <span style="width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #94a3b8; display: inline-block;"></span>
          <strong>Near-normal</strong> (middle 33%)
        </span>
        <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">
          <span style="width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #d7191c; display: inline-block;"></span>
          <strong>Drier</strong> (bottom 33%)
        </span>
        ${isFiltering ? html`
          <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: #eff6ff; color: #1d4ed8; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid #bfdbfe;">
            <span>⭕ Highlighted: ${similarYearsSet.size} Similar Years (${(similarYearsMode || 'projected') === 'recent' ? 'Pre-Season Lead-in' : 'Projected Peak'})</span>
          </span>
        ` : ''}
        <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-left: auto;">
          <span style="border-top: 2px dashed #0284c7; width: 22px; display: inline-block;"></span>
          <span>OLS Linear Regression Trendline</span>
        </span>

  `;
}

  if (host) {

      html`<div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.65rem; width: 100%; background: #f8fafc; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">

plotFlood = {
  const fmt = d3.format(",.0f");
  const fmtDec = d3.format(",.1f");

  if (floodIsModelled) {
    const selectedRPs = (jrcRPs && jrcRPs.length > 0) ? [...jrcRPs].sort((a, b) => a - b) : [100];
    const safeRPs = selectedRPs.filter(x => Number.isFinite(x));
    const subRows = await dbExposure.query(`
      SELECT adm2_name AS subcounty, rp, flood_prone_km2, pop_exposed, pop_pct, roads_km_exposed, health_n_exposed, schools_n_exposed
      FROM exp_jrc
      WHERE ${normExpr("adm1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}' AND rp IN (${safeRPs.join(",")})
      ORDER BY subcounty ASC, rp ASC
    `);

    // Seasonal Regime Callouts
    const regimeEl = html`
      <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr)); gap: 0.85rem; margin-top: 0.25rem;">
        <div style="background: #f0f9ff; border: 1px solid #bae6fd; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.75rem 1rem;">
          <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem;">

            <span style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.82rem; color: #0369a1; text-transform: uppercase;">
              Short Rains (OND) Flood Regime &bull; Riverine &amp; Basin-Scale

          </div>
          <div style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: #0c4a6e; line-height: 1.45; margin-top: 0.35rem;">
            Governed by <strong>El Niño and Positive Indian Ocean Dipole (+IOD)</strong> convective convergence. Characterized by prolonged, multi-week riverbank overtopping across Kenya's drainage basins. Historical analogues: <strong>1997, 2006, 2023</strong> (co-occurring El Niño &amp; +IOD) and <strong>2019</strong> (record +IOD during neutral ENSO).
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style="background: #fefce8; border: 1px solid #fef08a; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.75rem 1rem;">
          <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem;">
            <span style="display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ca8a04;"></span>
            <span style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.82rem; color: #854d0e; text-transform: uppercase;">
              Long Rains (MAM) Flood Regime &bull; Pluvial &amp; Flash Surges
            </span>
          </div>
          <div style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: #713f12; line-height: 1.45; margin-top: 0.35rem;">
            Driven by <strong>Western-V SST gradients and intense local convective cloudbursts</strong>. Characterized by rapid flash floods through dry seasonal riverbeds (<em>laggas / wadis</em>). Historical analogues: <strong>2018, 2024</strong>.
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    // Grouped Bars Plot
    const metricCol = floodMetric === "People exposed (%)" ? "pop_pct"
      : floodMetric === "Roads flooded (km)" ? "roads_km_exposed"
      : floodMetric === "Health facilities exposed" ? "health_n_exposed"

      },

        <strong>Critical Data Coverage Caution (HOT-OSM Crowdsourcing):</strong> Health center and school counts originate from crowdsourced OpenStreetMap (HOT-OSM). In remote ASAL subcounties, mapping is incomplete. <strong>A value of zero exposed schools reflects absence of volunteer mapped points, NOT immunity to floods.</strong>
      </div>
    `;

    const portalsEl = html`
      <div style="background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-size: 0.8rem;">

        <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem 1.25rem; margin-top: 0.4rem;">
          <a href="https://global-flood.emergency.copernicus.eu/glofas-forecasting/" target="_blank" style="color: #0284c7; text-decoration: underline; font-weight: 600;">JRC GloFAS Flood Portal &nearr;</a>
          <a href="https://emergency.copernicus.eu/" target="_blank" style="color: #0284c7; text-decoration: underline; font-weight: 600;">Copernicus Emergency Management Service &nearr;</a>

  } else {
    // Observed GFM Sentinel-1 SAR Mode
    const gfmRows = await dbExposure.query(`

    const chartEl = gfmRows.length ? Plot.plot({

    const tableEl = gfmRows.length ? html`

    return html`

        <div>${chartEl}</div>
        ${tableEl}
      </div>

}
table21Stats = {
  const chirpsRows = await dbChirps.query(`
    SELECT period,
           MIN(value_mean) AS min_val,
           MAX(value_mean) AS max_val,
           MEDIAN(value_mean) AS med_val,
           AVG(CASE WHEN year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2020 THEN value_mean END) AS clim
    FROM chirps_county
    WHERE ${normExpr("admin1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
      AND variable = 'PTOT' AND period IN ('OND', 'MAM')
    GROUP BY period
  `);
  const ondStat = chirpsRows.find((r) => r.period === "OND") || {min_val: 0, max_val: 0, med_val: 0, clim: 0};
  const mamStat = chirpsRows.find((r) => r.period === "MAM") || {min_val: 0, max_val: 0, med_val: 0, clim: 0};

  const peakRows = await dbChirps.query(`
    WITH base AS (
      SELECT period, year, value_mean,
             value_mean - AVG(CASE WHEN year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2020 THEN value_mean END) OVER (PARTITION BY period) AS anom
      FROM chirps_county
      WHERE ${normExpr("admin1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
        AND variable = 'PTOT' AND period IN ('OND', 'MAM')
    )
    SELECT period, year, value_mean, anom
    FROM base
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY period ORDER BY anom DESC) = 1
  `);
  const ondPeak = peakRows.find((r) => r.period === "OND") || {year: "—", anom: 0};
  const mamPeak = peakRows.find((r) => r.period === "MAM") || {year: "—", anom: 0};

  const floodRows = await dbExposure.query(`
    SELECT rp,
           SUM(flood_prone_km2) AS flood_km2,
           SUM(pop_exposed) AS pop_exp,
           SUM(pop_total) AS pop_tot,
           SUM(pop_exposed) / NULLIF(SUM(pop_total), 0) AS pop_pct_cty,
           STRING_AGG(adm2_name || ' (' || CAST(ROUND(pop_exposed) AS INT) || ' people)', ', ') AS subcounties
    FROM exp_jrc
    WHERE ${normExpr("adm1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}' AND rp = 100
    GROUP BY rp
  `);
  const floodStat = floodRows[0] || {flood_km2: 0, pop_exp: 0, pop_pct_cty: 0, subcounties: "None recorded"};

  return {ondStat, mamStat, ondPeak, mamPeak, floodStat};
}
